name: IB Economics Prep: Scarvane
subtitle: IB Economics SL/HL labs, mocks
shortDescription: Revise IB Economics your way: adaptive quizzes, 11 diagram labs, guided real-world builds and timed mock papers. SL and HL topics clearly marked.
longDescription:
IB Economics Prep: Scarvane is a revision companion for IB Economics at standard and higher level. It follows the four units of the current course (introduction, microeconomics, macroeconomics and the global economy) with HL extensions clearly marked.

### Learn Your Way
- Syllabus view in classical order, or Real-World view with guided builds
- 136 short lessons with worked examples, common mistakes and real-world hooks
- 585 original questions: multiple choice, calculations, short answer and explain, each with marking-style feedback
- Adaptive plan: wrong answers lead to the idea to revise, and the app explains why each step is next

### Practise Like the Exam
- Quizzes by topic, by command term or by your gaps
- Timed mock papers in the style of Paper 1, Paper 2 and the HL Paper 3, with a report and study plan
- Command term trainer and an internal assessment coach for your three commentaries and their key concepts

### Labs and Builds
- Eleven interactive diagram labs: production possibilities, supply and demand with surplus, elasticity and revenue, aggregate demand and supply, tax and subsidy incidence, externalities, monopoly, the multiplier, Lorenz curve and Gini, tariffs and quotas, and exchange rates
- Four guided builds: advise on a carbon tax, plan a recession response, judge a trade deal, explain a currency move

### Made for Every Screen
- Text size from 50% to 300%, phone and tablet layouts, works offline
- A Coverage screen showing exactly what is included, and an Other boards map to GCSE, A Level and AP equivalents
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
